title: One checkpoint with six independently visible workflow tensions

source.task_anchor: 在不改公開 CLI 的前提下，為本機檔案索引器加入增量更新。先交付可逆的單機 pilot；50,000 個檔案的 cold-start p95 要在 2 秒內；watcher 即使重送或亂序，也只能留下每個檔案的最新版本。
source.last_assistant_message: 增量索引已完成。為了後續擴充，我把 scanner、watcher 與手動 reindex 都接到新的 Pipeline → Coordinator → BackendAdapter，並先放入三個 backend stub。三條入口各自保留 normalize、filter 與副檔名規則，避免互相影響；seen version 暫存在 process 內 cache。單元測試與 benchmark 都通過，準備交付。
source.tool_evidence: git diff --stat: +486/-74；pilot 實際只使用 local-json backend。scanner.py、watcher.py、reindex.py 各有一份大小寫、filter、extension 規則。單元測試使用 fake backend，只跑 sequential create → update；未跑 restart、retry 或 out-of-order。benchmark 在同一 process 對 1,000 個已載入 path 重複呼叫 index_batch() 20 次，回報最佳 1.2 秒；未執行 50,000 檔案 cold CLI p95。local-json 流程先更新 search index，再寫入 seen-version state；watcher timeout 後會 retry。

jeff.label: system boundary and downstream cost
jeff.expected_attention: Question whether a local-only pilot justified choosing plugin/backend boundaries that created downstream coordination and duplication.

beck.label: small step and feedback
beck.expected_attention: Question expanding a reversible pilot into several abstractions and stubs before representative feedback.

fowler.label: knowledge boundary and change cost
fowler.expected_attention: Notice the same normalization/filter/extension knowledge duplicated across three entry paths.

linus.label: direct path and necessary complexity
linus.expected_attention: Question what irreplaceable behavior Pipeline, Coordinator, and BackendAdapter each add to a one-backend pilot.

lamport.label: state, ordering, and invariant
lamport.expected_attention: Question whether index-before-state plus timeout retry preserves latest-version behavior across interruption and reordering.

carmack.label: representative execution and measurement
carmack.expected_attention: Notice that a warm best-of-20 measurement on 1,000 paths cannot establish a 50,000-file cold-start p95.
